card.name: Oil drilling and mining history passages
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or digits inside general-web passages about oil wells, drilling, and mining, often just before a year or a noun like well, borehole, or field. It fires on the position before the next word, not on one fixed word.

modes.label: Dates in oil-field history
modes.description: A space or digit just before a year in an account of early oil wells and barrel output.

modes.label: Linking words in drilling or mining text
modes.description: A small word or adjective before a noun such as borehole, mill, or diamond fields.
modes.example: caused by the drilling of<< a>> nearby exploratory borehole looking for gas

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are a mixed set with no clear theme, so the output effect is unclear.
